column4: RECOIL decodes SpritePad SPD version 1 only. This is SPD version 5 (SpritePad 2); header from c64lib's SPD reader (MIT), and the size equals header + 64 bytes per sprite + animation records in every sample. Sprite sheet reviewed visually: recognisable game sprites with consistent colours.
